shared_runtime_structure.clean_startup: Storage key wds-design-gallery-v1 preserved; migrations wds-design-choice-v1 and wds-appearance-navy-v1 preserved; ?design=classic session-only recovery preserved. appearance-boot.js removes the delayed Original-to-selected repaint. shared_runtime_structure.legacy_bridge: Until Section 4 replaces them, My duties, Manage, and the Presider planner run through one `legacy` screen: the shell body hosts the existing renderMy/renderManage/renderSongs output inside a .wd-legacy container, with the existing Original content rules scoped under that class. This is the one compatibility wrapper the plan allows; Section 4 removes it screen by screen.
shared_runtime_structure.build_and_release: design-gallery/build.mjs becomes a packager (copies appearance-boot.js, shared/, layouts/, styles/; stamps ?v=DEV and the service worker RELEASE; runs verifyLayouts() and syntax checks). No longer reads prototype/, prototype-prism/, or docs/design/. design-gallery/test.mjs and live-design/ target the retired compiler and are superseded, not repaired (per S2-LAYOUT-INTERFACE.md section 8).
shared_runtime_structure.open_item_for_anthony: Prism and Aurora live light/dark and motion toggles are not in the approved Weekbook prototype. Section 2 did not invent them and left the stored wds-prism-palette keys untouched; Anthony needs to rule on this before Section 6.

server_workflows.status: built on claude/compact-server, per S3-SERVER-INTERFACE.md and S3-MEMBERSHIP-INTERFACE.md

modules.purpose: Pure. currentRevision(doc), nextRevision(doc), assertFresh({ expectedRevision, expectedWitness, currentRevision, currentWitness, details }). Shared version-aware-save primitive; no database, no imports beyond Node.

Pure server copies of song-lib.js's serviceIdFor/recompute/applySung/removeHistoryEntry semantics, plus applyCorrection for authorized corrections. Does not require the root song-lib.js (deploy package boundary).
Factory createCompactWorkflowHandlers({ db, now, permissionConfig, logger }): saveMemberAvailability, resolveDutyAttention, saveSongService, correctSongHistory, recordSongHistory.
Extended: revision added to PROFILE_METADATA_FIELDS (spread into PROFILE_ALLOWED_FIELDS); exported effectiveAvailability.

Extended: updateProfile moved into a transaction with assertFresh/revision; assignDepartmentDuty/overrideDepartmentAssignment/unassignDepartmentDuty accept optional expectedRevision/expectedMemberName, bump schedule/{id}.assignmentRevisions[duty], return revision; errorWithCode carries optional details; exported inputData/profileRef/assignmentForSchedule/assignmentRecord/errorWithCode/rejectDecision for compact-workflows.js reuse.

exposeDepartmentCallable forwards error.details into HttpsError; wires the four new callables (saveMemberAvailability, resolveDutyAttention, saveSongService, correctSongHistory); adds songHistoryRecorder (onSchedule, every 30 minutes); reconcileScheduleAssignmentProjection gains self-healing Needs-replacement marker removal and writes revision.
revision added to departmentProfileKeysSafe and assignmentKeysSafe read/write-shape allowlists.
